reproduction_check: V5's stored ranked + p_vector reproduced from agent_matrix + weights on 500/500 questions (exact order, |dp| < 1e-12)

i_fitted_weights.source: configs/v5.yaml, equal field-by-field to the V5 run's config.yaml

within_question.scope: within-question (each term demeaned per question -- the ranking-relevant decomposition, softmax is shift-invariant per question)

requested_alpha_s_pos_alone.note: argmax of alpha*s_pos alone. alpha is fitted NEGATIVE, so this is argmin s_pos -- the option with the FEWEST SUPPORT cells.

s_pos_alone_sign_free.note: argmax s_pos: the option with the MOST SUPPORT cells (the evidential direction)

iv_zero_support_wins.definition: pred option has s_pos == 0 while >= 1 other option has s_pos > 0 (identical to v5_diagnostics.json (c) 'of_those_where_some_OTHER_option_did_have_SUPPORT'). Compared against S* = the supported option with the highest z (V5's own tie-break) -- the hardest supported competitor P had to beat. winning_term = the term with the largest positive (P - S*) contribution to the margin; decisive_terms = terms whose removal alone flips P vs S*.
